routeHint: Any Customization settings page (languages is used) so the left Settings menu shows its Customization section. routeHint: Settings -> Customization -> Languages. IMPORTANT: the existing image was captured with multi-language support off, which hides the language list. Switch 'Enable Multi-language Support' on before capturing so the 'Available Languages' checkbox grid and the narrowed 'Select default language' dropdown are both visible. Do not press Save.

routeHint: Settings -> Customization -> Texts. The table must hold saved rows at the moment of capture, otherwise it renders the 'No text replacements yet' empty state, which teaches nothing. Seed tenant.setting_label with the four rows the page documents (Unit -> Team, Units -> Teams, Local center -> Chapter, Local centers -> Chapters) before capturing. RESET setting_label to [] immediately after this capture and after text-replacement-search: those overrides rename menu entries in every other screenshot taken from this tenant. SETUP/TEARDOWN REQUIRED, so this spec is parked at status keep: re-running it without the setup reproduces exactly the defect it fixed. Setup: UPDATE tenant SET setting_label = '{"Unit": {"en": "Team", "system": {"en": "Unit"}}, "Units": {"en": "Teams", "system": {"en": "Units"}}, "Local center": {"en": "Chapter", "system": {"en": "Local center"}}, "Local centers": {"en": "Chapters", "system": {"en": "Local centers"}}}' WHERE id = 282; Teardown, immediately after the capture: UPDATE tenant SET setting_label = '[]' WHERE id = 282. The teardown is not optional: those overrides rename interface phrases in every other screenshot taken from this tenant.
alt: Text Replacements table with four saved rows pairing a System Expression EN value with the organization's Custom Expression EN replacement

routeHint: Settings -> Customization -> Texts -> click 'Add Text Replacement', type into the search box, then tick two results so the footer button shows a real count. TRAP: the old waitFor 'text=Add (' matched 'Add (0)' the instant the modal rendered, so the capture fired before anything was typed and the result area was blank. The fill also has to be written 'fill <selector> | <value>' with a pipe, or run.mjs passes an empty value. waitFor 'text=Add (2)' cannot match until both ticks have landed. SETUP/TEARDOWN REQUIRED, so this spec is parked at status keep: re-running it without the setup reproduces exactly the defect it fixed. Setup: UPDATE tenant SET setting_label = '{"Unit": {"en": "Team", "system": {"en": "Unit"}}, "Units": {"en": "Teams", "system": {"en": "Units"}}, "Local center": {"en": "Chapter", "system": {"en": "Local center"}}, "Local centers": {"en": "Chapters", "system": {"en": "Local centers"}}}' WHERE id = 282; Teardown, immediately after the capture: UPDATE tenant SET setting_label = '[]' WHERE id = 282. The teardown is not optional: those overrides rename interface phrases in every other screenshot taken from this tenant.
alt: Add Text Replacement panel searching for local center, with a checkbox list of matching interface phrases and the capitalised and lowercase forms of the same phrase both ticked so the footer button reads Add (2)

routeHint: Settings -> Customization -> Dashboard Welcome. The page is headed 'Welcome Messages by User Type', so it has to show user-type messages: with only the default message present, DashboardWelcomeTemplate.loadData() auto-opens that one card in edit mode and the list view is never seen. Seed at least two non-default messages with selectedUserTypeIds pointing at real user types before capturing.

routeHint: Settings -> Customization -> Dashboard Welcome, then click 'edit' on the first card. The auto-open that used to make this shot free only happens when the default message is the only message, which is no longer true now that user-type messages are seeded, so the click is required. The selector crops to the card being edited: rich text editor, the 'Available Placeholders: {firstName} {lastName}' hint, the 'Welcome message Image URL' field and the Sticky switch next to Save and cancel. 2026-11-11: the editor is open as soon as the page loads (Save, Cancel and the heading menu are on screen), because the auto-open rule applies again: the docs tenant has only one message. The click text=edit had no target and was removed; a wait 1500 lets the editor finish rendering.
